title: Coverage gate set to 60%, not the documented 80%
evidence: pyproject.toml '--cov-fail-under=60'; CLAUDE.md repeatedly states 80%
recommendation: Reconcile gate with docs: raise gate to 80 or correct docs to 60.
status_note: Re-verified 2026-10-02: pyproject.toml still sets --cov-fail-under=60; CONTRIBUTING.md now states the 80% target and the 60% gate explicitly.

title: CONTRIBUTING tells new devs to use Poetry; project is uv
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:36-40 'poetry install --with dev'; pyproject build-backend hatchling, uv.lock present, no [tool.poetry]
recommendation: Replace Poetry block with 'uv sync --extra dev' and 'uv run pre-commit install'.
status_note: PR #199 converted CONTRIBUTING.md and AGENTS.md to uv. ADR-0018 still records Poetry as accepted, so DOC-05 remains partially fixed. README.md's Poetry references are tracked separately.

title: Dockerfiles build via Poetry against a missing poetry.lock
evidence: Dockerfile:26 copies 'poetry.lock*' (no poetry.lock exists), :34 'poetry export'; build resolves fresh from PyPI, bypasses uv.lock
recommendation: Switch Docker build to uv (uv export / uv pip install against uv.lock) for reproducible builds.
status_note: Re-verified 2026-10-02: Dockerfile:19-34 still installs Poetry and runs poetry export against poetry.lock*.

title: Multiple config systems, no single source of truth
evidence: Hand-rolled Settings in core/config.py:14 vs pydantic APISettings in api/config.py:17; 8 config modules plus ~15 inline *Config dataclasses
recommendation: Standardize on pydantic-settings BaseSettings; core owns root config, subpackage configs are nested models.

title: Two logging setups; dedicated logging/ package near-dead
evidence: setup_logging/get_logger defined in both logging/__init__.py:297,419 and utils/log_config.py:33,119; utils version has 57 importers, logging package ~2
recommendation: Merge logging/ setup into utils/log_config.py; keep logging/ for errors/outcomes types only.

title: Vulnerable transformers 4.37.2 pinned transitively via pyiqa
evidence: uv.lock pins transformers 4.57.3 (project) and 4.37.2 (forced by pyiqa 0.1.14.1); transformers <4.48 has deserialization/ReDoS RCE
recommendation: Pin pyiqa to a release allowing transformers>=4.48 or drop pyiqa from production extras; confirm iqa extra is not in any runtime image.
status_note: Re-verified 2026-10-02: uv.lock on main still resolves transformers 4.37.2 alongside 4.57.3.

title: basedpyright (house type checker) run in neither CI nor pre-commit
evidence: pyproject.toml:87 declares basedpyright as modern checker, :86 marks mypy legacy; ci.yml:316 runs mypy, pre-commit runs mypy v1.8.0; basedpyright runs nowhere
recommendation: Add 'uv run basedpyright src' to quality-checks and a pre-commit hook, or formally demote basedpyright in docs. Pick one gate.

title: README architecture/phase contradicts CLAUDE.md
evidence: README.md:130,398,553 Phase 0 week 2-3, ResNet IQA PLANNED; CLAUDE.md:644 Phases 0-6 COMPLETE, :511 ResNet student val_loss=0.14
recommendation: Pick one status source (CLAUDE.md is newer); rewrite README status/roadmap or link to MASTER_PROJECT_PLAN.md.
status_note: Re-verified 2026-10-02: README.md:398 still reads "Phase 2: ResNet Teacher & Student ML IQA (Week 2-4) PLANNED" and :553 "Phase 0 (Foundation) - Week 2-3". PR #209 did not touch README.md.

title: CLAUDE.md header model (SigLIP/MobileNetV4) contradicts its own body (ResNet)
evidence: CLAUDE.md:146-148 current = MobileNetV4 + SigLIP 2; :358,511,561 describe ResNet-50/18 as implemented; :644 says SigLIP 2 PENDING
recommendation: Add current-vs-target note: ResNet shipped, SigLIP/MobileNetV4 target; tag the SigLIP block forward-looking.
status_note: Fixed on main by PR #209 (2aa038f6): CLAUDE.md header now reads "Target Architecture" and ResNet is marked historical.

title: SigLIP and docling shifts have no ADR; duplicate ADR numbers 0028/0030
evidence: No ADR mentions SigLIP; layout ADR is 0015-yolov8 while CLAUDE.md:148 says docling replaced YOLOv10; duplicate 0028 and 0030 files; 0034 missing
recommendation: Add ADRs for SigLIP-2 teacher and docling-layout adoption; renumber duplicate 0028/0030 pairs.

title: Detectors ignore central Settings; 210 hardcoded thresholds
evidence: core/config.py imported by 4 files, none in detection/; 210 hardcoded float literals across detection/*.py (e.g. blank_page_detector.py:49, discrepancy.py:170)
recommendation: Route detector thresholds through core.Settings or per-detector config loaded from it; centralize tuning.

title: Oversized modules; iqa_classical.py is 2,845 lines
evidence: iqa_classical.py 2845 lines / 67 functions; generator.py 1735, iqa_ml.py 1520, dqs_calculator.py 1507, schema.py 1411; top-20 src files all >800 lines
recommendation: Split iqa_classical.py one module per detector; extract long methods.

title: Two divergent copies of the autogenerated requirements files
evidence: Both root and requirements/ carry the same uv-export header but drift: gitpython 3.1.46 vs 3.1.49; root copies last changed 2026-03-07, requirements/ on 2026-05-07
recommendation: Keep one canonical location, delete the other, add a CI check that fails if uv export differs from the committed file.
status_note: Fixed on main by PR #202 (03a7c73f): requirements/ and the root requirements-api.txt and requirements-ml.txt copies were removed. Root requirements.txt and requirements-dev.txt remain as the single set.

title: Unpinned doclayout-yolo and abandoned fasttext
evidence: doclayout-yolo declared bare (no version), resolves 0.0.4; fasttext>=0.9.3 resolves 0.9.3, no PyPI release since Apr 2024 (18+ months)
recommendation: Add version floor and upper bound for doclayout-yolo; document fasttext as frozen or evaluate lingua/fasttext-wheel.

title: 59 type/pyright-ignores, 14 clustered in monitoring/__init__.py
evidence: grep type:/pyright: ignore = 59 in src; monitoring/__init__.py holds 14 (24%)
recommendation: Audit the 14 ignores in monitoring/__init__.py; clusters usually mean one untyped import a stub/cast fixes.

title: Zero-assert security test file; 138 runtime skips
evidence: test_codeql_validation.py has no assert/raises (bodies are try/except pass CodeQL bait); 138 pytest.skip() runtime guards mostly fixture-availability
recommendation: Mark the file as a static-analysis fixture not a pytest test; audit how many fixture-skips fire in CI.

title: Three model lineages coexist in detection/; production path unmarked
evidence: detection/ contains siglip2_multitask.py, iqa_ml.py (ResNet), doclayout_yolo.py simultaneously; CLAUDE.md presents conflicting current models
recommendation: Mark production vs retired model modules in detection/__init__.py; pick authoritative pipeline in CLAUDE.md.
status_note: PR #209 marks ResNet as legacy in docs; the three model lineages in src/image_preprocessing_detector/detection/ are unchanged.

title: AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING prescribe Poetry/Black/isort/mypy; module map stale
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:44-46,105-134 and AGENTS.md:11-19 say poetry/black/isort/mypy; reality uv+ruff+basedpyright; AGENTS.md:7 omits annotation/labeling/synthetic/drift
recommendation: Update both docs to uv+ruff+basedpyright; expand module map to list the largest subpackages.
status_note: PR #199 updated AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md (uv, ruff format, expanded module map, and MyPy documented as the CI gate with BasedPyright as the stricter local check).

title: torch.load(weights_only=False) on config-driven checkpoints
evidence: siglip2_multitask.py:236-239 and run_model_benchmark.py:331,542,825,931 use weights_only=False; regression.py:171 already uses weights_only=True (inconsistent)
recommendation: Use weights_only=True for plain state_dicts or prefer safetensors; document trust boundary for remaining calls.

title: mypy config drifts between pre-commit and CI
evidence: pre-commit (:66) runs mypy v1.8.0 with --ignore-missing-imports and ~9 excluded files; ci.yml:316 runs mypy src --config-file=pyproject.toml full scope
recommendation: Point pre-commit mypy at the same config and scope as CI; align pinned version with uv-resolved one.

title: .semgrep.yaml ruleset executed by no workflow
evidence: grep semgrep in workflows matches only sonarcloud.yml nosemgrep comments; security-analysis.yml:257-258 delegates semgrep to Cloud App; local ruleset never run
recommendation: Add 'semgrep --config .semgrep.yaml' to security-analysis.yml, document the cloud app consumes it, or delete the file.

title: bandit scan is non-blocking, contradicting stated policy
evidence: security-analysis.yml:250-255 runs 'bandit -r src ... || true' twice; CLAUDE.md says fail on HIGH/CRITICAL
recommendation: Drop '|| true' or gate on severity (bandit -r src -ll), keep JSON artifact upload under if: always().

title: Hardcoded foreign path /home/byron in CLAUDE.md setup commands
evidence: CLAUDE.md:331,1022 PYTHONPATH=/home/byron/dev/image_detection (does not exist on clone); 949 /home/byron + /mnt/e hits across docs
recommendation: Replace with PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) or repo root; sweep the doc-wide hits.
status_note: PR #199 replaced the two hardcoded PYTHONPATH commands in CLAUDE.md; other /home/byron references remain across docs.

title: Stale '1,292 files mapped' count; inventory self-flagged STALE
evidence: CLAUDE.md:50 '1,292 files mapped'; target file header flags STALE (Jan 2025); repo now 3,834 tracked files, 971 .py
recommendation: Drop the count from CLAUDE.md or replace with a regenerate-via-script pointer.
status_note: PR #199 removed the stale "1,292 files" count from CLAUDE.md.

title: Base runtime still targets Python 3.10 (EOL ~Oct 2026)
evidence: pyproject.toml:9 requires-python >=3.10,<3.15; CPython 3.10 end of security support Oct 2026 (~5 months from audit)
recommendation: Plan to raise floor to >=3.11 before Oct 2026; verify no dep needs 3.10 resolution. Crosses to High inside the 6-month window.

title: 815 Any annotations weaken strict typing on src
evidence: grep Any in src = 815; worst logging/__init__.py 26, cli.py 20, synthetic/validation.py 18; basedpyright is strict on src
recommendation: Replace boundary Any with TypedDict/pydantic models where shape is known; keep Any only at dynamic edges with a comment.

title: Layering inversion: top-level schema.py imports annotation subpackage
evidence: schema.py:19 imports annotation.schemas.enums.CaptureMethod; schema.py imported by 17 files yet depends down into annotation/ (latent inversion, no cycle yet)
recommendation: Move shared enums to schema_utils/ or a new core/enums.py so base schema does not depend on annotation.

title: trust_remote_code=True on caller-supplied model ids (17 occurrences)
evidence: regression.py:189,209,215 and siglip.py:278,282 pass trust_remote_code=True on caller-supplied model_path/spec.id; 17 total in src/scripts/modal
recommendation: Set trust_remote_code=False for first-party checkpoints; gate True behind an allowlist and pin revision to a full SHA.

title: sonarcloud re-runs full pytest on every PR, duplicating ci.yml
evidence: sonarcloud.yml:25-26 triggers on every PR, :103 runs pytest --cov; ci.yml:173,236 already runs pytest with coverage across 5 versions
recommendation: Have sonarcloud consume ci.yml coverage artifact via workflow_run + download-artifact (same pattern as codecov.yml).

title: 20 broken (originally reported as 18) relative links in README
evidence: 18 MISSING link targets incl. docs/planning/PROJECT_PLAN.md (the '114-page plan', linked twice at :250,:347), docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE_SUMMARY.md, docs/api-reference.md
recommendation: Repoint to current paths (e.g. docs/planning/MASTER_PROJECT_PLAN.md) or remove dead entries.
status_note: PR #199 repointed 3 targets; 17 unique missing README link targets remain (20 at the merge base, measured 2026-10-02).

title: annotation/ god-package: 33% of LOC, own CLI/logging/config/metrics
evidence: annotation/ = 130 .py files, 34,787 LOC (33% of package); has own cli.py (annotate entry point), monitoring/logging.py, config/settings.py, metrics
recommendation: Treat annotation/ as a candidate for extraction into its own package or document it as a distinct application boundary.

title: SBOM excludes the iqa extra (pyiqa) by design
evidence: sbom.yml:55-70 omits --extra iqa due to conflicting transformers pins; comment states 'only package missed is pyiqa'
recommendation: Generate a separate SBOM for the iqa extra and merge, or note the gap in SBOM metadata.

title: Unreferenced deprecated datetime compat shims (0 call sites)
evidence: utcnow_compat() :305 and utcfromtimestamp_compat() :317 self-documented deprecated; zero call sites outside the file
recommendation: Delete the two *_compat() shims; no consumers.
status_note: tests/unit/test_datetime_compat.py imports and tests both shims; they are intentionally retained wrappers.

title: Unreferenced deprecated alias ValidationResult
evidence: checkpointing.py:463 ValidationResult = CheckpointValidationResult tagged deprecated; no usages of the alias name elsewhere
recommendation: Remove the alias; nothing imports it.

title: Deprecated schema field handwriting_detected retained
evidence: schema.py:1084 field description 'DEPRECATED: use handwriting_assessment.presence_score'; name appears once in src
recommendation: Confirm no Project B handoff consumer depends on it, then drop on next schema version bump.

title: Commented-out parser code block in template
evidence: template.py:244-290 ~12-line commented-out CSV reading stub; accounts for most of the 12 commented-code lines in src
recommendation: Replace the commented stub with a docstring example or raise NotImplementedError.
status_note: annotation/parsers/template.py is a code generator; the flagged block is an instructional example inside a template string.

title: os.path in one file vs stated pathlib standard
evidence: All 5 os.path.join calls in src are in metadata_generator.py (:133,170,281,315,347); CONTRIBUTING.md:166 sets pathlib as standard
recommendation: Convert this one file to pathlib.Path; rest of codebase already complies.
status_note: PR #199 converted os.path.join calls in utils/metadata_generator.py to pathlib; covered by 37 passing unit tests.

title: Stray % / .format() string formatting outside logging
evidence: 218 %-style literals but 138 are correct lazy-logging; only ~2 stray manual % plus migrations.py:751,782 .format() worth converting
recommendation: Convert the stray manual % strings and migrations.py .format() to f-strings; leave logging placeholders.
status_note: migrations.py .format() fills a user-configured runtime template; an f-string cannot do that.

title: 62 ruff errors, 60 are str-Enum modernization (UP042)
evidence: ruff --statistics: 60 UP042 replace-str-enum, 1 ASYNC240, 1 FURB171; 61 of 62 auto-fixable
recommendation: Migrate class X(str, Enum) to enum.StrEnum; investigate the single ASYNC240 blocking-IO-in-async by hand.

title: Orphan CLI module cli_layout.py wired to no entry point (false positive: imported at cli.py:1145)
evidence: pyproject [project.scripts] declares only imgprep and annotate; cli_layout.py (361 LOC) referenced by no entry point or module
recommendation: Register cli_layout as a subcommand under imgprep or remove it.
status_note: cli_layout.py is imported at cli.py:1145 and registered as the imgprep layout group; it is not an orphan.

title: Ad-hoc torch.cuda.is_available() bypasses device_probe (6-10 sites)
evidence: device_probe.py and orchestration/device_orchestrator.py exist, yet docling_layout.py:127,161, yolo.py:103,142, arena/inference/local.py:208,234 use raw torch.cuda.is_available() (merges CQ-07)
recommendation: Request devices through DeviceOrchestrator/device_probe so GPU-priority and budget policy apply uniformly.

title: Expired .snyk ignore for ONNX CVE-2025-51480
evidence: .snyk ignore expires 2025-02-22, about 15 months before the 2026-05-29 audit; onnx 1.20.1 in uv.lock
recommendation: Re-review and re-date the ignore (or remove if a fixed onnx exists); verify save_external_data still unused.

title: API key check is not constant-time
evidence: middleware.py:257 'if api_key not in self.api_keys' set-membership, not timing-safe
recommendation: Compare with hmac.compare_digest against hashed candidates, or accept as low-risk given high-entropy keys behind TLS.

title: setup-uv pinned to 4 different versions across workflows
evidence: setup-uv@ uses v5 (12), v5.4.2 (3), v4.2.0 (1, codeql.yml:52), v7.6 (1, slsa-provenance.yml:59)
recommendation: Standardize all workflows on one SHA-pinned setup-uv version (v7.x line); update codeql.yml off v4.2.0.

title: python-compatibility re-runs pytest overlapping ci.yml matrix
evidence: python-compatibility.yml:40 tests 3.10-3.13 and :45 runs full pytest; ci.yml:173 matrix already covers 3.10-3.14
recommendation: Narrow python-compatibility to versions ci.yml does not cover, or run an import/smoke check.

title: typing.Optional instead of X | None (123 uses, 56 files)
evidence: 123 Optional occurrences across 56 of 299 src files (19%); List/Dict/Tuple/Union already at 0; requires-python >=3.10
recommendation: Migrate Optional[X] to X | None; enable Ruff UP045/UP007 to auto-fix and prevent regression.

title: 77 TODO/FIXME/XXX markers, oldest sampled 2025-11-16
evidence: 63 TODO, 13 XXX, 1 FIXME; git blame dates oldest sampled marker to 2025-11-16 (ingestion/document_processor.py:88); no HACK
recommendation: Triage the 13 XXX markers first; convert actionable TODOs to tracked issues.

title: 58 hand-written to_dict and 15 inline 0-1 clamps; missing helpers
evidence: 58 to_dict defs, 15 from_dict, 15 inline max(0,min(1,...)) clamps, 10 normalize helpers; pydantic v2 already provides model_dump
recommendation: Add one clamp01() util; audit to_dict methods on pydantic models for redundancy with model_dump().

title: API upload buffers full body before size check (memory-DoS)
evidence: process.py:323-341 'content = await file.read()' reads full upload before size check; validate_file ignores max-size arg; MIME mismatch only logged
recommendation: Enforce a Content-Length cap before reading the body and stream to temp file in bounded chunks.
